changes.title: AWS Network Firewall introduces automated Internet firewall in public preview
changes.detail: AWS Network Firewall announces the public preview of automated Internet firewall, a new centralized control that allows you to configure Network Firewall, with native network address translation (NAT) capability, on the internet gateways of all the Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs) in your environment. Using automated Internet firewall mode, you can centrally define your Network Firewall security rules and enforce them on all inbound and outbound traffic across the internet gateways of your VPCs. You are not required to make routing or architectural changes to deploy automated Internet firewall. Y

changes.title: Amazon RDS for Oracle now supports Replica First Patching for reduced downtime
changes.detail: Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) for Oracle now supports Replica First Patching, which reduces downtime during minor version upgrades. Replica First Patching is available for Enterprise Edition DB instances. With Replica First Patching, you apply a minor version upgrade to a replica in the same AWS Region first while your primary DB instance continues to serve traffic, and then switch over to the replica when you're ready to complete the upgrade. If the replica is in read-only mode, you can validate the new minor engine version with your read traffic. Replica First Patching help

changes.title: Cloud Scheduler: Feature (November 20, 2026)
changes.detail: Cloud Scheduler support for customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) is generally available ( GA ). You can use symmetric keys that you manage in Cloud Key Management Service (Cloud KMS) to protect HTTP and Pub/Sub job data at rest.

changes.title: Cloud Storage: Feature (November 20, 2026)
changes.detail: In buckets with hierarchical namespace enabled, you can now use the JSON API folders.deleteRecursive method to delete a non-empty folder and all its contents in a single long-running operation. For more information, see Delete a folder .
